title: Community Learning Hubs for Rural Youth
problemStatement: Rural young people in underserved districts have limited access to safe learning spaces, digital skills and community dialogue opportunities.
objectives: Expand access to community learning spaces
outcomes: Stronger links between youth groups and local institutions

title: Women-Led Climate Resilience Cooperatives
problemStatement: Small farming households face rising climate and water pressures while women have limited access to productive assets and local decision-making.
outcomes: Greater participation of women in local planning

title: Youth Digital Peace Labs
summary: A network of youth-led learning sessions combining digital literacy, media literacy and community dialogue.

title: Digital skills cohort outcome
indicator: Participants completing practical digital skills training
baseline: Limited access to structured digital training
target: 80% of enrolled participants complete the core modules
evidence: Attendance records and pre/post skills assessment
